Pickle Roll Ups
By: Anonymous
Published: Tuesday, December 1, 2009 - 11:31pm

Ingredients




1 jar Pickles, dill
1 pkt Cream cheese
3 pkt Smoked meat, thin sliced

Preparation

1 Cook Time: none Roll picklecompletely in cream cheese between hands. Wrap in 1 layer of meat. Chill for at least 1 hour. Then slice rolls into wheels, the pickle will be surrounded by the cream cheese and then the meat. 2 From Neil's mom,originally from Florida
